item.content:encoded:
I believe that the FBI has a duty to protect the nation from anything and everything. Because of this, the federal government or leaders of the FBI may want to either (1) Keep their own records of SCP's because the Foundation is unknown to them or (2) to keep tabs on the Foundation as a sort of "This is what the Foundation did today" sort of thing.

It kind of reminds me of the X-Files. They investigated things that were already controlled by the government on some level. Sometimes they even investigated the government. Something similar to that is my best guess.

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
DrMagnus is absolutely correct about the scientific parts of US government. From personal knowledge, it's not true in the accounting/billing parts or Internal Business parts.1 I've heard military use kilometers and pounds in the same sentence, so I think SI use is uneven there. I assume Federal Law enforcement would be similar to military use.

My guess is that standard UIU format would be to use both, as

Item weighs 110 pounds (50 kg). Item affects area within a radius of 6 miles (10 km).

That, or the reverse, pretty common in US-centric publications. From a OOC perspective, it says this is American, without alienating International readers.

Footnotes
1. Metric is used in international business, however
